explanation: Under Peter the Great, Russia set one rouble equal to 100 kopecks in 1704. Revolutionary France introduced the decimal franc in 1795, alongside the metric system.

claims.text: Russia made its currency decimal in 1704, under Peter the Great, with one rouble equal to 100 kopecks.
France adopted a decimal currency, the franc of 100 centimes, in 1795.
France's decimal franc was introduced alongside the metric system.
